lint: No lint script/config in the repository; TypeScript and git diff --check passed.
review: Independent coordinator review reconfirmed the two financial P2 fixes; integrated UI review incorporated; native Tab trap and draft preservation rechecked.
failed_attempts_and_resolution: Older bell contracts adapted to dialog plus Ver mais; traceability references are explicitly expanded by the audit contract.
Initial native dialog focus restoration/Tab cycle failures corrected and final all-role keyboard cases passed.
One expanded Auth run timed out creating local Storage using vfs; isolated rerun passed; leftover disposable Created container cleanup requested.

Public dev tests used a build-only .env.local and parallel browser load: two connection-dependent cases and two multi-screen timeout cases failed. Public connection removed from dev; all four passed isolated without product changes.
Broad browser run overlapped source HMR and caught outdated/keyboard cases; final16 affected contracts passed with runtime source frozen.
limitations: No authenticated hosted business mutation performed.
Manual payment/refund records; no bank gateway or automatic due-date scheduler.
Vercel connector lacks project access; deploy proof uses existing GitHub status and canonical bundle.
Production artifact/schema and anonymous access barriers verified; authenticated business flow was validated in the local lab, without hosted business mutations.
